reviews.text:
We see so much information online, and every professional points in a different direction, right? That was leaving us completely confused, so we decided to look for a professional who could take care of our four-legged friend in person, without our assumptions, you know? hahaha

And the reason I'm here is because I've had an incredible experience with Rodrigo the dog trainer :))) It's shocking to see how his techniques have worked since the first lesson; I really didn't think it would be possible to change his behavior in such a short time and in such a gentle way. He's been behaving much better, without ceasing to have fun <3 Thank you for everything!

My goal with this review is to share my experience and warn other women so they know what happened to me before deciding to hire Rodrigo.

I hired Rodrigo to conduct 10 lessons with each of my two dogs. In addition to the lessons, I practiced with them alone for about an hour daily. After 7 lessons, I asked if he expected my dogs to have shown any improvement in their reactivity, and if I could do something different in the training sessions I was doing alone, as I hadn't noticed any changes in their behavior up to that point.

At that moment, Rodrigo became very angry and started yelling at me. I tried to calm him down and asked him to sit down so we could talk civilly, but he continued yelling.

At one point, already in the building's hallway, I asked him not to yell there because I was embarrassed by the situation. He insisted he would continue yelling. I was alone at home and, given the intensity of the yelling and the whole situation, I felt afraid for my safety. The situation escalated to the point where I had to call the building superintendent to report what was happening. After the incident, I informed the building management that he was no longer authorized to enter the building. I was also warned that he continued shouting loudly at the entrance.

In previous classes, there were other people at home, and I had never witnessed this type of behavior from him. Therefore, I was even more surprised by what happened that day.

I consider the way I was treated extremely serious, especially because it all started inside my own home, while I was alone, and escalated to the building's hallway, to the point where I felt afraid and needed to alert the building management. Based on this experience, I definitely do not recommend the service.

I consider it important to share what happened, mainly as a warning to other women who are considering hiring this service, so that they know about my experience before making their decision.

Rodrigo is simply incredible and magical!

It's admirable to see how he conducts the classes and communicates with the dogs. Our dog, Café, has a difficult history; he's reactive and, in some situations, aggressive. That's why we sought his help to learn how to handle him in the best way.

The 10 basic lessons made a huge difference. Today we can control him much better during walks, and we've noticed he's more attentive, balanced, and learning more and more.

However, training doesn't end in class. Everything we learn needs to be practiced daily, and we've been following this routine. The results are evident precisely because of this partnership between Rodrigo's work and our dedication at home.

We are very grateful for his professionalism, patience, and knowledge. I recommend him without hesitation!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amy attends the Ademar Venâncio Training Center, and our experience has been excellent. The work done is very serious, professional, and always focused on the well-being of the dogs. Ademar demonstrates impressive knowledge of canine behavior and training, as well as great patience and dedication to each animal.

It's possible to perceive the individualized care and affection with which he conducts the training, respecting the characteristics of each dog. Amy loves going to classes, and we've noticed a very positive evolution in her behavior and in our relationship with her.

I recommend the Ademar Venâncio Training Center to any owner seeking quality training, conducted by an extremely competent professional who is passionate about what he does. Congratulations to Ademar for the excellent work! 🐾👏🏻

I have so much to thank Rodrigo and Daniel for their support during Archie's first training sessions. Their dedication and the way they conducted the process made all the difference. Today I have a much more balanced and calm dog every day 🐶 …

I can only express my gratitude for all the excellent work Rodrigo has done and continues to do! Even in the first lesson, we saw an improvement we never thought possible! Cristal is getting better and better, and I must mention the care and attention Rodrigo gives her. Wonderful work. ❤️

I used to think dog training was a whim, an unnecessary luxury. But Rodrigo has been showing – with technique and empathy – that it's fundamental, especially in the first months of a dog's life. It's made all the difference. The dog's behavior is calmer and more predictable. And so is that of his owners. I recommend him.

I started training in March. I'm a first-time pet owner, and as such, confused. With all the information on the internet about handling and behaving like each dog, doubts quickly arose. As a result, I was behaving in a confused way, not like a dog. Today, I feel more confident with Rodrigo's mentoring, and my puppy enjoys training with him. I notice she comes back tired, but happy because she had a lot of fun. So, I definitely recommend him 👍 to understand how to have a healthy relationship and routine with my puppy.

Good morning! Our experience with training our pet was wonderful, her development improved a lot. Our bulldog was very stressed and Rodrigo managed to reverse that, thank God!

All the beds we bought, our bulldog ate, and after the training, incredibly, lol, today she sleeps in her bed and didn't eat any!

The stress, her coat improved a lot, I loved it! Thank you so much Rodrigo 🙏🙏🙏🙏😃

Excellent professional.
We hired him for the training course and also for the boarding service.
The work of slowing Paçoca down was essential for her interaction with cats and a baby.
With Rodrigo's work, our Paçoca is much calmer and less anxious, and we expect more progress throughout the course.
Excellent service, professionalism, promptness, and good results. Congratulations!
Rodrigo has a lot of experience with animals, and my dogs (one 5 years old and a 5-month-old puppy) are improving a lot in their behavior!

I noticed a huge difference (for the better) in my dogs' behavior right from the first lesson!
I recommend it to everyone who wants balanced and obedient dogs!

Rodrigo is very sensitive and gets straight to the point. His "root method" solved the most serious problems we had with our newly arrived bonsai dog and improved the entire relationship between humans and pets in our home. I recommend him.
Excellent, behavior improved 100% after starting training. I recommend it to everyone who wants to train their dogs to have better behavior at home!!!
I'm seeing great results with Rodrigo's training; in just 5 lessons we've already made a lot of progress. I highly recommend it.
